      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||

        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)

            }

      }

      function setLanguagePickerUi(langCode) {

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

      languageDropdown.addEventListener(

          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false
      );

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      for (const langCode in translations) {

        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = langCode;
        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);
      }

              el.className = "visible";
            }
          },

        );
      }

          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

        return iso ? languageFlagCdnBase + iso + ".png" : "";
      }

      function setLanguagePickerUi(langCode) {
        var label = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var url = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        languageDropdownBtnLabel.textContent = label;

          languageDropdownBtnFlag.src = url;

          row.classList.toggle(

          );
        });
      }

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

      languageDropdown.addEventListener(

          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }

      for (const langCode in translations) {

        opt.value = langCode;
        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);

          var img = document.createElement("img");

          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);

      var translationMap = {};

        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);

        var label = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var url = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        languageDropdownBtnLabel.textContent = label;
        if (url) {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.src = url;
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.alt = "";
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";

          languageDropdownBtnFlag.removeAttribute("src");
        }
        languageDropdownBtnFlag.style.display = url ? "" : "none";

          row
        ) {
          row.classList.toggle(
            "bn-cap-lang-item-active",
            row.getAttribute("data-lang") === langCode
          );
        });
      }

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

        "change",
        function () {
          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false
      );

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {

        }
      });

        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);

          "click",
          function () {

            if (el.className === "visible") {
              el.className = "invisible";
            } else {
              el.className = "visible";
            }
          },
          false
        );
      }

    <script>
      var translationMap = {};

      function translate(browserLanguages) {
        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);
    </script>

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

<script>

      var fallbackLanguage = { code: "en" };

      var rawServerLang = "";
      var serverPreferredLangCode =
        typeof rawServerLang === "string"
          ? rawServerLang.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "")
          : "";

      var browserLanguages;
      if (
        serverPreferredLangCode !== "" &&
        typeof translations[serverPreferredLangCode] !== "undefined"
      ) {
        browserLanguages = [
          { code: serverPreferredLangCode },
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      } else {
        browserLanguages = [
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      }

      var languageDropdown = document.getElementById("languageDropdown");
      var languageDropdownBtn = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtn");
      var languageDropdownMenu = document.getElementById("languageDropdownMenu");
      var languageDropdownBtnFlag = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnFlag");
      var languageDropdownBtnLabel = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnLabel");

      function languageFlagUrl(langCode) {
        var iso = languageFlagIso[langCode];
        return iso ? languageFlagCdnBase + iso + ".png" : "";
      }

      function setLanguagePickerUi(langCode) {
        var label = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var url = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        languageDropdownBtnLabel.textContent = label;
        if (url) {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.src = url;
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.alt = "";
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        } else {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.removeAttribute("src");
        }
        languageDropdownBtnFlag.style.display = url ? "" : "none";
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(languageDropdownMenu.querySelectorAll("li"), function (
          row
        ) {
          row.classList.toggle(
            "bn-cap-lang-item-active",
            row.getAttribute("data-lang") === langCode
          );
        });
      }

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      function openLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      }

      languageDropdown.addEventListener(
        "change",
        function () {
          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false
      );

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      for (const langCode in translations) {
        var langLabel = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = langCode;
        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);
      }

      setLanguagePickerUi(languageDropdown.value);

      // More info dropdown

      var moreInfoDropdown = document.getElementById("moreInfoDropdown");
      if (moreInfoDropdown) {
        moreInfoDropdown.addEventListener(
          "click",
          function () {
            var el = document.getElementById("moreInfo");
            if (!el) return;
            if (el.className === "visible") {
              el.className = "invisible";
            } else {
              el.className = "visible";
            }
          },
          false
        );
      }

    <script>
      var translationMap = {};

      function translate(browserLanguages) {
        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);
    </script>

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }

        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {

            ).forEach(function (element) {

                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }

        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);
      }

      setLanguagePickerUi(languageDropdown.value);

      // More info dropdown

      var moreInfoDropdown = document.getElementById("moreInfoDropdown");
      if (moreInfoDropdown) {
        moreInfoDropdown.addEventListener(
          "click",
          function () {
            var el = document.getElementById("moreInfo");
            if (!el) return;
            if (el.className === "visible") {
              el.className = "invisible";
            } else {
              el.className = "visible";
            }
          },
          false
        );
      }
    </script>

    <script>
      var translationMap = {};

      function translate(browserLanguages) {
        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);
    </script>

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

      var fallbackLanguage = { code: "en" };

      var rawServerLang = "";

        typeof rawServerLang === "string"
          ? rawServerLang.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "")
          : "";

      var browserLanguages;
      if (
        serverPreferredLangCode !== "" &&
        typeof translations[serverPreferredLangCode] !== "undefined"
      ) {
        browserLanguages = [
          { code: serverPreferredLangCode },
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      } else {
        browserLanguages = [
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      }

      var languageDropdown = document.getElementById("languageDropdown");
      var languageDropdownBtn = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtn");
      var languageDropdownMenu = document.getElementById("languageDropdownMenu");
      var languageDropdownBtnFlag = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnFlag");
      var languageDropdownBtnLabel = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnLabel");

      function languageFlagUrl(langCode) {
        var iso = languageFlagIso[langCode];
        return iso ? languageFlagCdnBase + iso + ".png" : "";
      }

      function setLanguagePickerUi(langCode) {
        var label = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var url = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        languageDropdownBtnLabel.textContent = label;
        if (url) {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.src = url;
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.alt = "";
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        } else {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.removeAttribute("src");
        }
        languageDropdownBtnFlag.style.display = url ? "" : "none";
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(languageDropdownMenu.querySelectorAll("li"), function (
          row
        ) {
          row.classList.toggle(
            "bn-cap-lang-item-active",
            row.getAttribute("data-lang") === langCode
          );
        });
      }

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      function openLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      }

      languageDropdown.addEventListener(
        "change",
        function () {
          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false
      );

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      for (const langCode in translations) {
        var langLabel = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = langCode;
        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);
      }

      setLanguagePickerUi(languageDropdown.value);

      // More info dropdown

      var moreInfoDropdown = document.getElementById("moreInfoDropdown");
      if (moreInfoDropdown) {
        moreInfoDropdown.addEventListener(
          "click",
          function () {
            var el = document.getElementById("moreInfo");
            if (!el) return;
            if (el.className === "visible") {
              el.className = "invisible";
            } else {
              el.className = "visible";
            }
          },
          false
        );
      }

    <script>
      var translationMap = {};

      function translate(browserLanguages) {
        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);
    </script>

      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

          : "";

      var browserLanguages;
      if (
        serverPreferredLangCode !== "" &&
        typeof translations[serverPreferredLangCode] !== "undefined"
      ) {
        browserLanguages = [
          { code: serverPreferredLangCode },
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      } else {
        browserLanguages = [
          ...parse(window.navigator.language),
          fallbackLanguage,
        ];
      }

      var languageDropdown = document.getElementById("languageDropdown");
      var languageDropdownBtn = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtn");
      var languageDropdownMenu = document.getElementById("languageDropdownMenu");
      var languageDropdownBtnFlag = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnFlag");
      var languageDropdownBtnLabel = document.getElementById("languageDropdownBtnLabel");

      function languageFlagUrl(langCode) {
        var iso = languageFlagIso[langCode];
        return iso ? languageFlagCdnBase + iso + ".png" : "";
      }

      function setLanguagePickerUi(langCode) {
        var label = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var url = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        languageDropdownBtnLabel.textContent = label;
        if (url) {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.src = url;
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.alt = "";
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        } else {
          languageDropdownBtnFlag.removeAttribute("src");
        }
        languageDropdownBtnFlag.style.display = url ? "" : "none";
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(languageDropdownMenu.querySelectorAll("li"), function (
          row
        ) {
          row.classList.toggle(
            "bn-cap-lang-item-active",
            row.getAttribute("data-lang") === langCode
          );
        });
      }

      function closeLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = true;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      function openLanguageMenu() {
        languageDropdownMenu.hidden = false;
        languageDropdownBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      }

      languageDropdown.addEventListener(
        "change",
        function () {
          var code = languageDropdown.value;
          setLanguagePickerUi(code);
          translate([{ code: code }, fallbackLanguage]);
        },
        false
      );

      languageDropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {
          openLanguageMenu();
        } else {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("click", function () {
        closeLanguageMenu();
      });

      languageDropdownMenu.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === "Escape") {
          closeLanguageMenu();
        }
      });

      for (const langCode in translations) {
        var langLabel = languages[langCode] || langCode;
        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = langCode;
        opt.textContent = langLabel;
        opt.selected = browserLanguages[0].code === langCode;
        languageDropdown.appendChild(opt);

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);
        if (flagUrl) {
          var img = document.createElement("img");
          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";
          img.width = 20;
          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });

      var translationMap = {};

          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");

          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {

              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }

    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>

        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {

        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);

          li.appendChild(img);

        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);

          languageDropdown.value = code;

          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");

            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {

            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

        if (languageDropdownMenu.hidden) {

      });

        var li = document.createElement("li");
        li.setAttribute("role", "option");
        li.setAttribute("data-lang", langCode);
        var flagUrl = languageFlagUrl(langCode);

          img.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-flag";
          img.src = flagUrl;
          img.alt = "";

          img.height = 14;
          img.loading = "lazy";
          img.decoding = "async";
          img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
          li.appendChild(img);
        }
        var span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "bn-cap-lang-item-label";
        span.textContent = langLabel;
        li.appendChild(span);
        li.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var code = langCode;
          languageDropdown.value = code;
          languageDropdown.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
          closeLanguageMenu();
        });
        languageDropdownMenu.appendChild(li);
      }

      setLanguagePickerUi(languageDropdown.value);

            }
          },
          false
        );
      }

    <script>
      var translationMap = {};

      function translate(browserLanguages) {
        if (rtlLanguages.indexOf(browserLanguages[0].code) !== -1) {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
        } else {
          document.body.setAttribute("dir", "ltr");
        }

        browserLanguages.reverse().forEach((lang, idx) => {
          if (typeof translations[lang.code] !== "undefined") {
            var languageMap = translations[lang.code];

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(languageMap)) {
              translationMap[key] = value;
            }
          }
        });

        for (const key in translationMap) {
          if (translationMap.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
            const replace = translationMap[key];
            Array.from(
              document.getElementsByClassName("js-lang-" + key)
            ).forEach(function (element) {
              if (element) {
                element.innerHTML = replace;
              }

              if (element.value) {
                element.value = replace;
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      translate(browserLanguages);
    </script>

    <script>
      var regex = /((([a-zA-Z]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+){0,2})|\*)(;q=[0-1](\.[0-9]+)?)?)*/g;

      var isString = function (s) {
        return typeof s === "string";
      };

      function parse(al) {
        var strings = (al || "").match(regex);
        return strings
          .map(function (m) {
            if (!m) {
              return;
            }

            var bits = m.split(";");
            var ietf = bits[0].split("-");
            var hasScript = ietf.length === 3;

            return {
              code: ietf[0],
              script: hasScript ? ietf[1] : null,
              region: hasScript ? ietf[2] : ietf[1],
              quality: bits[1] ? parseFloat(bits[1].split("=")[1]) : 1.0,
            };
          })
          .filter(function (r) {
            return r;
          })
          .sort(function (a, b) {
            return b.quality - a.quality;
          });
      }

      function pick(supportedLanguages, acceptLanguage, options) {
        options = options || {};

        if (
          !supportedLanguages ||
          !supportedLanguages.length ||
          !acceptLanguage
        ) {
          return null;
        }

        if (isString(acceptLanguage)) {
          acceptLanguage = parse(acceptLanguage);
        }

        var supported = supportedLanguages.map(function (support) {
          var bits = support.split("-");
          var hasScript = bits.length === 3;

          return {
            code: bits[0],
            script: hasScript ? bits[1] : null,
            region: hasScript ? bits[2] : bits[1],
          };
        });

        for (var i = 0; i < acceptLanguage.length; i++) {
          var lang = acceptLanguage[i];
          var langCode = lang.code.toLowerCase();
          var langRegion = lang.region
            ? lang.region.toLowerCase()
            : lang.region;
          var langScript = lang.script
            ? lang.script.toLowerCase()
            : lang.script;
          for (var j = 0; j < supported.length; j++) {
            var supportedCode = supported[j].code.toLowerCase();
            var supportedScript = supported[j].script
              ? supported[j].script.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].script;
            var supportedRegion = supported[j].region
              ? supported[j].region.toLowerCase()
              : supported[j].region;
            if (
              langCode === supportedCode &&
              (options.loose ||
                !langScript ||
                langScript === supportedScript) &&
              (options.loose || !langRegion || langRegion === supportedRegion)
            ) {
              return supportedLanguages[j];
            }
          }
        }

        return null;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
    function bnCaptchaResolveDark() {
      try {
        var t = localStorage.theme;
        if (t === "dark") return true;
        if (t === "light") return false;
        return window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function bnCaptchaApplyTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", bnCaptchaResolveDark());
      var icon = document.getElementById("theme-toggle-icon");
      if (!icon) return;
      icon.textContent = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? String.fromCodePoint(0x2600, 0xfe0f)
        : String.fromCodePoint(0x1f319);
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          localStorage.theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
            ? "light"
            : "dark";
          bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
        });
      }
      bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
    });
    try {
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (!("theme" in localStorage)) bnCaptchaApplyTheme();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    </script>
